title: Khandā
text: 2--33. Pañcime bhikkhave upādānakkhandhā || katame pañca || seyyathīdaṃ || || Rūpūpādanakkhando vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhando saṅkhārūpādānakkhandho {viññāṇūpādānakkhando} [page 061] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 61 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || ime kho bhikkhave pañcūpādānakkhandhā || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya || la || ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || ||
